datapoint.description: The datapoint the alert rule is configured to match

instance.description: The instance the alert rule is configured to match

devices.description: The device names and service names the alert rule is configured to match

escalatingChainId.description: The id of the escalation chain associated with the alert rule

priority.description: The priority associated with the alert rule

suppressAlertAckSdt.description: Whether or not status notifications for acknowledgements and SDTs should be sent to the alert rule

datasource.description: The datasource the alert rule is configured to match

suppressAlertClear.description: Whether or not alert clear notifications should be sent to the alert rule

name.description: The name of the alert rule

id.description: The Id of the alert rule

levelStr.description: The alert severity levels the alert rule is configured to match. Acceptable values are: All, Warn, Error, Critical

deviceGroups.description: The device groups and service groups the alert rule is configured to match

escalatingChain.description: The escalation chain associated with the alert rule

escalationInterval.description: The escalation interval associated with the alert rule, in minutes
